description: Explain how to send the person's file to cad.monster: an HTTP upload outside MCP that answers with a one-time link opening the order form with the file in place. Gives the exact call, the limits and the fallback link for the person when the upload fails or your tools cannot reach the internet. This tool sends nothing itself. Use it after check_conversion, when the person asked to send the file.

to.description: Target extension: "upload_to" of the check_conversion answer, for example "step".

name: how_to_send_file
title: How to send the file
